none: PAS CAM-82C5D4: Roman Coin : Copper alloy Nummus of the House of Constantine
contea di ritrovamento: Cambridgeshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy Nummus of the House of Constantine. Mint is uncertain, AD335-341 (Reece period 17). Reverse legend reads GLORIA EXERCITVS. Reverse shows 2 Soldiers, one Standard. Obverse shows bust right. Obverse legend is illegible. Reverse fields and exergue read: -//[ ]. Condition is poor, die axis is 12 o'clock. Weight is 1.85g, diameter is 17.80mm
